name: Devexhub Image Gallery
author: devexhubprivatelimited

sections.description:
Devexhub Image Gallery helps you create beautiful and responsive image galleries with ease. You can upload, organize, and display images using flexible layouts and modern features.

Features

  • Easy-to-use admin interface
  • Fully responsive design
  • Multiple gallery layouts
  • SEO-friendly (alt text, captions)
  • Lightbox and fullscreen view
  • Gutenberg compatible
  • Bulk image upload
  • Image watermarking
  • EXIF data display
  • Category-based filtering
  • Image sorting options

Usage

  1. Go to Devexhub Image Gallery in admin panel
  2. Upload images
  3. Configure settings
  4. Display gallery using shortcode
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/devexhub-image-gallery directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Use the plugin from the admin dashboard
sections.faq:
Is it compatible with all themes?

Yes, it works with most modern WordPress themes.

Does it support Gutenberg?

Yes, it is fully compatible with the block editor.

Is it responsive?

Yes, it works on all devices.

  • Initial public release
  • Responsive gallery system
  • Multiple layouts
